g.title: public.organizations
g.text: A landlord's organisation. Readable in its own context, by its members and by admin; updated only by its landlord or admin.

g.title: public.leases
g.text: A tenancy of one unit. One live (pending/active/notice) lease per unit.

g.title: public.users
g.text: People who can sign in. Not org-owned (no RLS); anonymised on account deletion.
